title: The sprint skill's run step submits land, stage-back and sync as jobs, follows them with the Monitor tool and goes on to the next ready item
goal: the kb-sprint skill (in the clone and in the plugin's copy) tells the orchestrator, when python3 _tools/kbjob.py ping exits 0, to submit each landing, stage-back and sync --push with kbjob.py submit OP ID --by claude-<8 hex>, to follow it with one Monitor call on kbjob.py follow JOB (a line per move; a waiting-merge line is the cue to run backlog.py merge ID or tell the operator) or a background shell on the same command, and to go on at once with dispatching and claiming the next ready items and answering gates, instead of one background land ID > log per landing and a coord.py wait; a follow that ends with exit 4 is run again with its --since; the existing path stays for a host where ping exits 1 and for a headless worker; .claude/settings.json allows python3 _tools/kbjob.py submit, follow, status, log, cancel, ping and ensure and never serve or login-item; kb/_self/backlog.md describes the job step beside the run states
